title: Printful vs Printify 2026: Which POD Partner Should You Choose?
metaDescription: I tested both POD giants for 6 weeks — print quality, shipping times, pricing, and real margins. Here is my honest Printful vs Printify comparison for 2026.
tldr: Printify wins on price and catalog size — up to 40% lower base costs and 850+ products, best for margin-focused sellers.
Printful wins on quality consistency and in-house fulfillment — better for branded merch and repeat orders.
My pick for most sellers: Printify for scale, Printful for premium lines. Start with whichever matches your order volume.

blocks.text: I run a small POD store on Etsy and I have spent the last 6 weeks testing both Printify and Printful side by side: same designs, same products, same destinations. This is my honest, hands-on comparison — no affiliate fluff, just what I measured.
Quick Verdict: Which One Should You Pick?
If you are margin-hungry and selling on Etsy or Amazon, Printify is the better default. If you sell branded merch where quality consistency is the brand, Printful justifies its premium.

rows: Etsy, Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, TikTok Shop

blocks.text: I ordered the same three products (t-shirt, mug, tote) from both providers at the same time and measured: print quality at 300 DPI, color accuracy vs the source file, packaging, and door-to-door delivery time.

blocks.alt: Side-by-side print quality comparison of Printful vs Printify t-shirt samples
blocks.caption: Left: Printify sample. Right: Printful sample. Same source file, both at 300 DPI.

blocks.text: Print Quality: Printful Still Edges It Out

The difference is small but real: Printful's DTG prints held slightly more detail in the highlight areas, and their white-base layer was more opaque on dark garments. Printify's quality depends heavily on which print provider you pick inside their network.
Rule of thumb: on Printify, always filter by the top 3 print providers per product (e.g. Monster Digital, SwiftPOD, District Photo). Provider quality varies far more than platform quality.

pros: Printify: up to 40% lower product base costs
Printify: free plan with 20+ product slots (5 on free tier)
cons: Printful: premium price — $8.95 vs $4.45 base t-shirt
Printful: smaller catalog, fewer product variants
Printful: mockup generator is basic vs Mockey

items: Choose Printify if: you sell on Etsy/Amazon, test new designs often, and margin matters more than perfect consistency.
Choose Printful if: you sell branded merch, need in-house design help, or want the most predictable quality.
Use both: many sellers run Printify for A/B testing designs and Printful for the winners.

faqs.a: Printify is cheaper on almost every product — a standard t-shirt costs about $4.45 on Printify vs $8.95 on Printful. Both have free plans with no monthly fee.

faqs.q: Which has better print quality, Printful or Printify?
faqs.a: Printful has slightly more consistent DTG quality because they own their fulfillment. Printify's quality varies by the print provider you choose inside their network.

faqs.q: Can I use Printify and Printful at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes — many sellers use both: Printify for testing new designs and Printful for their best sellers. Both integrate with Etsy, Shopify, and Amazon.
In my tests, US shipping averaged 5-9 days for Printify and 4-7 days for Printful. Both offer faster (paid) shipping options.
